notes: Who/what this bid is (trade, doc type: full plan set / thin invite email / image-only drawings), and where it came from. Keep it real.

expected.building_type: Healthcare | Office | Education | Government | Industrial | Multifamily | Retail | Religious | Higher Education | Mixed-Use | Infrastructure | Other

extracted_snapshot._comment: Paste EXACTLY what the app extracted for this bid (from the report or console). This is what gets graded against `expected`. Refresh it after a prompt/model change to catch regressions.

scored_snapshot._comment: What the app scored this bid, for the profile it was scored against. Optional but recommended — enables recommendation-band + score-delta grading.
